name: qlrisk_price_cdo
title: Price a CDO
description:
Price one Collateralized Debt Obligation (qlrisk CDO): NPV, pricing components and Greeks where the pricer gives them.
Inputs (* required): maturity* (tenor like 3Y or date), face_value (amount; default 100), recovery_pct (percent, 3 = 3%; default 40), correlation (0 to 1; default 0.3), attachment_pct (percent, 3 = 3%; default 3), detachment_pct (percent, 3 = 3%; default 7), pool (default GLOBEX), coupon_bp (basis points, 25 = 0.25%; default 300), currency (see the schema's list; default USD). Rates are in percent, spreads in basis points, maturities a tenor (3Y, 18M, 6W, 10D) or a date YYYY-MM-DD. Optional `advanced`: trade_id, trade_date, effective_date, counterparty_id, position, market_data, reporting_currency, include_cash_flows; market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "face_value": 100} gives NPV 50.78 USD on the sample market valued 2026-10-09. For several trades at once use qlrisk_price_trades.
